CyclePhases.4: Ukwezi kwawe kugizwe n’ibyiciro bitandukanye, buri kimwe gifite uruhare rukomeye mu ngano y’imisemburo yawe no mu buzima bwawe.
CyclePhases.8: Impamvu gusobanukirwa ukwezi kwawe ari ingenzi
CyclePhases.10: Ukwezi kwawe muri rusange kugabanyijemo ibyiciro bine by’ingenzi. Uburebure bwabyo bushobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi: buri mubiri ufite injyana yawo.
CyclePhases.20: Buri mugore ni umwihariko: itegereze umubiri wawe maze umenye injyana yawe.
CyclePhases.21: Impinduka z’imisemburo zishobora kugira ingaruka ku mbaraga zawe, ku marangamutima, ku gusinzira, no ku byiyumvo bimwe by’umubiri mu gihe cy’ukwezi.
CyclePhases.23: Imbaraga zawe zishobora kuba nke kandi umubiri wawe ushobora gukenera kuruhuka cyane.
CyclePhases.25: Imbaraga ziyongera buhoro buhoro kandi ushobora kumva ufite imbaraga nyinshi.
CyclePhases.27: Abagore bamwe bumva bafite imbaraga, ishyaka no kwigirira icyizere.
CyclePhases.29: Umunaniro, kubyimba inda, cyangwa impinduka z’amarangamutima bishobora kugaragara.
CyclePhases.31: Nta buryo bumwe gusa bwo guhura na buri cyiciro. Ibyiyumvo byawe bwite bikomeza kuba umuyobozi mwiza.
CyclePhases.32: Kumenya neza ukwezi kwawe bishobora kugufasha guteganya ibihe bimwe no gusobanukirwa impinduka ubona buri munsi.
CyclePhases.34: Guteganya imihango yawe n’ibyiciro byayo bitandukanye
CyclePhases.36: Guhuza ibyo ukora n’urwego rw’imbaraga zawe
CyclePhases.38: Dore ibisubizo bimwe ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku byiciro bitandukanye by’ukwezi.
CyclePhases.39: Ese ni ibisanzwe ko ukwezi kwanjye kudamara iminsi 28 neza?
CyclePhases.40: Yego. Uburebure bw’ukwezi bushobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi, ndetse gato no ku kwezi ku kundi.
CyclePhases.41: Ese ovulation iba buri gihe ku munsi wa 14?
CyclePhases.42: Oya. Umunsi wa 14 ni igereranyo gisanzwe ku kwezi kw’iminsi 28, ariko ovulation ishobora kuba mbere cyangwa nyuma.
CyclePhases.43: Kuki ibimenyetso byanjye bihinduka bitewe n’icyiciro?
CyclePhases.44: Impinduka z’imisemburo mu gihe cy’ukwezi zishobora kugira ingaruka ku mbaraga, ku marangamutima, ku gusinzira, no ku byiyumvo bimwe by’umubiri.
CyclePhases.45: Ese ni byiza gukurikirana ibimenyetso byanjye?
CyclePhases.46: Yego. Kubyandika buri gihe bishobora kugufasha kumenya imiterere yawe no gusobanukirwa neza injyana yawe.
CyclePhases.48: Uko urushaho kwitegereza ukwezi kwawe, ni ko urushaho gusobanukirwa icyo bisanzwe kuri wowe.

CycleVitalSign.6: Impamvu ukwezi rimwe na rimwe kwitwa “ikimenyetso cya gatanu cy’ubuzima.”
CycleVitalSign.12: Gukurikirana ukwezi kwawe kugira ngo wimenye neza
CycleVitalSign.30: Ukwezi guterwa n’imikorere y’imisemburo y’umubiri mu gihe cy’ukwezi. Kwiga kukwitegereza bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza uko umubiri wawe ukora, utarebye buri kantu gato.
CycleVitalSign.31: Dore ibintu by’ingenzi cyane byo kwitegereza:
CycleVitalSign.32: Nta kwezi kumwe gutunganye: buri mubiri ufite injyana yawo, kandi iyo njyana ishobora no guhinduka gato ku kwezi ku kundi. Ukwezi gufatwa nk’ukwa buri gihe iyo kumara hagati y’iminsi 21 na 35, kandi imihango akenshi imara iminsi 3 kugeza kuri 7.
CycleVitalSign.33: Iyi mibare ni ibigereranyo: impinduka nto zikomeza kuba ibisanzwe, cyane cyane nyuma yo gukura, nyuma yo kubyara, cyangwa menopause iri hafi.
CycleVitalSign.34: Impinduka zimwe zikwiye kwitonderwa kurushaho, nka:
CycleVitalSign.35: Impinduka igaragara mu buryo ukwezi gusanzwe
CycleVitalSign.36: Imihango irimo amaraso menshi kurusha uko bisanzwe
CycleVitalSign.40: Impinduka ikomeye isubiramo mu mezi menshi
CycleVitalSign.41: Ukwezi kumwe gusa kudasanzwe ntibivuze ko hari ikibazo cy’ubuzima: umubiri ushobora kubyitwaramo by’igihe gito bitewe n’ibintu byinshi bitandukanye.
CycleVitalSign.42: Izi mpinduka rimwe na rimwe zishobora guhuzwa n’ibintu bitandukanye, bitavuze ko ari ikibazo:
CycleVitalSign.43: Ibi ni bimwe mu bisobanuro bishoboka mu bindi: ntibisimbura inama z’umuganga.
CycleVitalSign.45: Kwandika amatariki yawe, amaraso, cyangwa uko wumva bigufasha kumenya ingeso zawe, ukwezi ku kundi.
CycleVitalSign.46: Umunsi wa mbere w’imihango, uburebure bwayo, amaraso, ububabare, amarangamutima, imbaraga, cyangwa ibisohoka mu gitsina ni ibintu ushobora kwandika uko igihe kigenda. Intego si ugereranya ukwezi kwawe n’ukw’undi, ahubwo ni ukumenya neza ibisanzwe kuri wowe, n’ibitandukanye na byo.
CycleVitalSign.47: Ni ibisanzwe rwose kugira ibibazo ku kwezi kwawe. Gusaba inama z’umuganga bishobora gufasha mu bihe bimwe, urugero:
CycleVitalSign.48: Impinduka zikomeye zikomeza mu mezi menshi
CycleVitalSign.49: Ububabare bukubuza gukora ibyo usanzwe ukora
CycleVitalSign.54: Kuvugana n’umuganga bishobora kugutuza cyangwa, nibiba ngombwa, kukugezaho ubufasha bukwiye — si impamvu yo guhangayika ubwayo.
CycleVitalSign.55: Ukwezi ntikwiye kuba gutunganye rwose ngo kube ari ibisanzwe. Kumenya injyana yawe isanzwe akenshi bifasha kurusha gushaka uburebure bwiza.
CycleVitalSign.56: Ukwezi kwawe ni kimwe mu bimenyetso byinshi by’ubuzima bwawe. Kugukurikirana buri gihe bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza umubiri wawe kandi, uko igihe kigenda, kubona impinduka zikwiye kwitabwaho by’umwihariko.
CycleVitalSign.57: Ukwezi kwawe, ikimenyetso cyiza cy’ubuzima — AWA

ExerciseCycleSupport.1:
Kora imyitozo
kugira ngo ushyigikire ukwezi kwawe
ExerciseCycleSupport.6: Impamvu imyitozo ngororamubiri ihoraho ishobora gushyigikira ingano y’ukwezi kwawe, ubwoko bw’imyitozo bwo guhitamo, n’uko wahuza umuvuduko wawe nta gahato cyangwa kwicira urubanza.
ExerciseCycleSupport.7: Si ugukora byinshi, ahubwo ni ugukora imyitozo ikubereye kandi ushobora gukomeza igihe kirekire.
ExerciseCycleSupport.9: Impamvu imyitozo ishobora gushyigikira ukwezi kwawe
ExerciseCycleSupport.10: Ni izihe nyungu ku kwezi kwawe?
ExerciseCycleSupport.18: Imyitozo ngororamubiri ihoraho igira ingaruka ku mikorere myinshi y’umubiri, harimo iyo mu kugenzura imisemburo no mu mikorere y’ukwezi. Ikora cyane cyane ku buryo umubiri wakira insuline, mu kugenzura guhangayika, no ku bwiza bw’ibitotsi — ibintu bitatu bifitanye isano n’ingano y’imisemburo.
ExerciseCycleSupport.19: Gukora imyitozo buri gihe ntibyemeza ukwezi “gutunganye”, ariko ni kimwe mu bintu bishyigikira ubuzima bwiza muri rusange, kandi ingaruka zabyo zishobora kugaragara mu kwezi ku bagore bamwe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.21: Isano iri hagati y’imyitozo ngororamubiri n’ukwezi ni iy’umuntu ku giti cye: abagore bamwe babona ingaruka zigaragara, abandi nke. Uko byagenda kose, ni ingeso ifite akamaro.
ExerciseCycleSupport.22: Imyitozo ihoraho ishobora gutanga umusanzu ku buryo butandukanye, nubwo izi ngaruka zidashidikanywaho cyangwa zimwe kuri bose:
ExerciseCycleSupport.29: Gufasha, ku bagore bamwe, ukwezi kuba gusanzwe kurushaho
ExerciseCycleSupport.30: Izi nyungu ziyongera buhoro buhoro: si ingaruka ihita iboneka nyuma y’isomo rimwe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.31: Nta myitozo “iruta” indi: ikora neza kurusha izindi ni iyo ukunda gukora buri gihe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.38: Nta tegeko rimwe rigenga bose: icy’ingenzi ni ugukora buri gihe aho kuba indashyikirwa. Gushyira mu munsi wawe utuntu duto two kwimuka (kugenda, kuzamuka ingazi, kurambura) bifite agaciro nk’imyitozo yateguwe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.39: Urwego rukwiye rw’imbaraga ruterwa n’uko umeze mu mubiri, ubuzima bwawe, imbaraga ufite muri icyo gihe, n’intego zawe bwite: icyorohera umwe ntikorohera undi.
ExerciseCycleSupport.41: Amasomo atatu magufi ku cyumweru, akomeje igihe kirekire, akenshi agira akamaro kurusha intego ikomeye ivanwaho nyuma y’iminsi mike.
ExerciseCycleSupport.42: Imbaraga n’uko wumva mu mubiri bishobora guhinduka mu gihe cy’ukwezi. Guhindura ubukana bw’imyitozo yawe hakurikijwe uko wumva ni uburenganzira bwawe bwose.
ExerciseCycleSupport.43: Mu gihe cy’imihango: kwimuka byoroheje niba bikubereye
ExerciseCycleSupport.44: Nyuma y’imihango: ongera buhoro buhoro niba imbaraga zawe zibyemera
ExerciseCycleSupport.45: Hafi ya ovulation: komeza imyitozo isanzwe ukurikije uko wumva
ExerciseCycleSupport.46: Mbere y’imihango: hitamo kwimuka ushoboye, ukaruhuka nibiba ngombwa
ExerciseCycleSupport.47: Ntabwo ari amategeko akomeye y’umubiri: buri mugore abona ukwezi kwe ukundi, kandi ibi ni ingero z’ibyo kugenderaho, si inshingano.
ExerciseCycleSupport.48: Ku bagore bafite PCOS, imyitozo ngororamubiri ihoraho ishobora kugira akamaro by’umwihariko: ishyigikira uko umubiri wakira insuline, uburyo bukunze guhungabana muri iki kibazo, kandi ishobora gutanga umusanzu mu kuringaniza imikorere y’umubiri n’imisemburo igihe kirekire.
ExerciseCycleSupport.50: Ntabwo ari umuti, ahubwo ni inkunga yuzuza kwitabwaho muri rusange, igomba guhuzwa na muganga.
ExerciseCycleSupport.51: Imyumvire itari yo cyangwa ingeso zimwe zishobora gukora nabi kurusha ibyiza:
ExerciseCycleSupport.53: Gutekereza ko imyitozo ikomeye gusa ari yo ifite akamaro
ExerciseCycleSupport.54: Gukora imyitozo ufite intego yo kugabanya ibiro gusa
ExerciseCycleSupport.56: Kwiyicira urubanza nyuma yo kubura isomo
ExerciseCycleSupport.57: Mu bihe bimwe, inama z’umuganga zigira akamaro cyane mbere yo gusubukura cyangwa guhindura imyitozo ngororamubiri:
ExerciseCycleSupport.63: Gusubukura imyitozo nyuma yo gutwita cyangwa kubyara
ExerciseCycleSupport.66: Kwimuka ntibigomba kuba bikomeye cyangwa bitunganye ngo bigire akamaro. Imyitozo ihoraho, ukunda kandi ushobora gukomeza ishobora gushyigikira ubuzima bwawe muri rusange kandi igatanga umusanzu, ku bagore bamwe, mu gucunga neza ukwezi.
ExerciseCycleSupport.68: Iyi nkuru igenewe amakuru rusange kandi ntisimbura inama z’umuganga. Buri gihe huza imyitozo ngororamubiri n’imiterere yawe bwite, kandi usabe inama umuganga niba ufite ikibazo.
ExerciseCycleSupport.69: Kora imyitozo kugira ngo ushyigikire ukwezi kwawe — AWA

FastingQadaa.6: Uko n’igihe cyo kwishyura iminsi y’isiyamu watakaje, ku muvuduko wawe nta kwicira urubanza.
FastingQadaa.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni iby’inyigisho gusa. Ibibazo by’idini bigomba kwemezwa n’abahanga babifitiye ububasha. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa imyanzuro y’idini yihariye.
FastingQadaa.11: Igihe gisanzwe: mbere ya Ramadan ikurikira
FastingQadaa.14: Qadaa ni ukwishyura nyuma iminsi y’isiyamu yatakaye muri Ramadan — cyane cyane kubera imihango. Iyi minsi igomba kwishyurwa kuko isiyamu ya Ramadan ikomeza kuba inkingi y’ukwezi, kandi iminsi ihagarikwa n’imihango ibarwa nk’iyo ugomba, bitavuze ko ari ikosa ryawe.
FastingQadaa.15: Kwishyura muri rusange bishobora gutangira Ramadan irangiye, iyo imiterere yawe ibyemeye. Ushobora gutegura iyi minsi ku muvuduko wawe: bamwe bahitamo kuyihuriza hamwe nyuma ya Ramadan, abandi bakayigabanya buhoro buhoro mu mezi akurikira.
FastingQadaa.17: Kwishyura iminsi ikurikirana cyangwa kuyigabanya bishobora kubonwa ukundi bitewe n’ishuri ry’amategeko; nta buryo bwombi bugaragazwa hano nk’ubwonyine bwemewe.
FastingQadaa.18: Andika umubare wose w’iminsi yo kwishyura Ramadan irangiye
FastingQadaa.19: Hitamo uburyo bworoshye: kalendari, porogaramu, ikayi
FastingQadaa.20: Shyira ikimenyetso ku munsi wose wishyuwe
FastingQadaa.21: Urugero, umuntu ufite iminsi 6 yo kwishyura ashobora guhitamo kwiyiriza umwe buri cyumweru mu byumweru bitandatu, cyangwa kuyihuriza hamwe mu gihe kimwe niba bimubereye.
FastingQadaa.22: Ni ibisanzwe kugerageza kwishyura iminsi watakaje mbere ya Ramadan ikurikira. Ibi ntibitegetswe buri gihe mu bihe byose, ariko byoroshya gutegura kandi birinda kwirundanya k’iminsi myinshi itarishyurwa.
FastingQadaa.24: Kugabanya iminsi yo kwishyura hakurikijwe gahunda yawe bigufasha gukomeza utuje, nta gahato.
FastingQadaa.25: Gutegura hakiri kare bifasha kwirinda guhangayika mu minota ya nyuma. Inama yoroshye ni ukubara iminsi isigaye mbere ya Ramadan ikurikira no kugabanya iminsi yo kwishyura mu byumweru cyangwa amezi asigaye.
FastingQadaa.27: Niba impamvu ihoraho cyangwa isubiramo ibuza kwiyiriza (uburwayi bumara igihe, urugero), imiterere ishobora kugengwa n’andi mategeko; icyo gihe ni ingirakamaro cyane kubiganiraho n’umuhanga ubifitiye ububasha.
FastingQadaa.29: Amategeko yihariye iyo igihe kirenze ashobora gutandukana bitewe n’uko basobanura. Ku kibazo cyose gikomeye, igitekerezo cy’umuhanga ubifitiye ububasha gikomeza kuba igisubizo.
FastingQadaa.30: Urugero, niba Ramadan ikurikira itangira mu mezi 8 kandi hasigaye iminsi 6 yo kwishyura, uburyo bumwe ni ugutegura umunsi umwe hafi buri kwezi, ukareka umwanya w’ibitunguranye.
FastingQadaa.31: Inda no konsa bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bushobozi bwo kwiyiriza, cyane cyane iyo kwiyiriza bishyira mu kaga ubuzima bw’umubyeyi cyangwa bw’umwana. Imibereho myiza y’umubiri n’ubushobozi nyabwo bwo kwiyiriza ni ibintu by’ingenzi byo kuzirikana.
FastingQadaa.33: Iyi miterere imenyekana n’imigenzo y’idini nk’ishobora gutuma habaho kubabarirwa.
FastingQadaa.34: Ibitekerezo by’idini ku kutiyiriza mu gihe cy’inda cyangwa konsa bishobora gutandukana bitewe n’ishuri, cyane cyane ku kibazo cy’uko kwishyura gusa bihagije cyangwa niba hari n’indishyi. Impamvu nyayo yo kutiyiriza n’imiterere bwite bishobora kugira ingaruka ku gisubizo gikwiye.
FastingQadaa.36: Qadaa igufasha kwishyura utuje iminsi y’isiyamu watakaje, ku muvuduko wawe. Mu miterere yihariye (igihe cyarenze, inda, konsa, inzitizi ihoraho), igitekerezo cy’umuhanga ubifitiye ububasha gikomeza kuba isoko nziza.

FertilityWindow.6: Impamvu iminsi iri hafi ya ovulation ari yo y’ingenzi cyane mu gusama.
FertilityWindow.9: Impamvu iyi minsi ari yo y’ingenzi cyane
FertilityWindow.12: Igihe cy’uburumbuke ni igihe cy’ukwezi kwawe gishobora gutwita. Kimara hafi iminsi 6: iminsi 5 mbere ya ovulation, hiyongereyeho umunsi wa ovulation ubwawo.
FertilityWindow.14: Buri kwezi kuratandukanye: igihe cy’uburumbuke ntikigwa ku munsi umwe wa kalendari buri gihe ku kwezi ku kundi.
FertilityWindow.15: Intanga zishobora kubaho kugeza ku minsi 5 mu nzira y’imyororokere, bigatuma igihe cyo gusama gishoboka kiba kinini. Igi ryo ribasha gusama gusa hafi amasaha 24 nyuma yo kurekurwa.
FertilityWindow.16: Urugero, imibonano mpuzabitsina ibaye iminsi 3 mbere ya ovulation ishobora gutuma usama, mu gihe iyo ibaye umunsi nyuma ya ovulation akenshi iba itinze.
FertilityWindow.17: Ibimenyetso byinshi, byitegerejwe hamwe, bigufasha kumenya neza iki gihe:
FertilityWindow.19: Kwitegereza ururenda rwo mu nkondo y’umura
FertilityWindow.20: Gupima ubushyuhe bw’umubiri bwa buri gitondo
FertilityWindow.23: Guhuza ibimenyetso byinshi (ukwezi, ururenda, ubushyuhe) bitanga ishusho yizewe y’igihe cy’uburumbuke bwawe kurusha ikimenyetso kimwe gusa.

FiqhWomenIntro.6: Incamake yuzuye y’ingingo z’ingenzi ziri muri fiqh y’abagore, hagati y’imigenzo y’idini n’ubuzima bwa buri munsi.
FiqhWomenIntro.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni iby’inyigisho gusa. Ibibazo by’idini bigomba kwemezwa n’abahanga babifitiye ububasha. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa imyanzuro y’idini yihariye.
FiqhWomenIntro.13: Fiqh, ubuzima, n’imigenzo ya buri munsi
FiqhWomenIntro.15: Ni ryari usaba inama umuntu ubifitiye ububasha?
FiqhWomenIntro.17: Fiqh y’abagore ni ishami rya fiqh y’Isilamu rireba ibibazo bifatika bijyanye n’umubiri w’umugore n’ugusenga. Ifasha gusobanukirwa uko wahuza ubuzima bwa buri munsi bw’idini n’ibyiciro bitandukanye by’ukwezi k’umugore.
FiqhWomenIntro.22: Salat mu gihe cy’imihango na nyuma yayo

FiqhWomenIntro.26: Ubuzima bwa buri munsi n’imigenzo y’idini
FiqhWomenIntro.27: Fiqh ni urwego rwo gusobanura amategeko: ibibazo bimwe bigira ibitekerezo bitandukanye bitewe n’abahanga n’amashuri, nta gitekerezo na kimwe kiba ihame ryonyine.
FiqhWomenIntro.28: Gusobanukirwa fiqh y’abagore bituma umuntu agira imigenzo y’idini ituje kurushaho, nta kwitiranya, mu bihe umubiri unyuramo ibyiciro byihariye (imihango, inda, nyuma yo kubyara, menopause). Binafasha gutandukanya icyo ari itegeko, kubabarirwa, cyangwa inama yoroshye.
FiqhWomenIntro.30: Kumenya ibyitezwe muri buri cyiciro cy’ukwezi bituma umuntu yegera kwizera ke yizeye kurushaho.
FiqhWomenIntro.31: Madhab ni ishuri ry’imitekerereze y’amategeko, ni ukuvuga uburyo buteguye abahanga bakoresha gusobanura inkomoko z’idini (Quran, Sunnah, ubwumvikane, gutekereza) no gusubiza ibibazo bifatika bya buri munsi. Hari amashuri menshi, kuko abahanga batakurikije buri gihe uburyo bumwe cyangwa ngo basobanure inyandiko zimwe kimwe.
FiqhWomenIntro.32: Ni yo mpamvu ibibazo bimwe bijyanye n’imihango, isuku y’idini, salat, cyangwa isiyamu bishobora kugira ibitekerezo bitandukanye bitewe n’abahanga babajijwe. Itandukaniro ry’ibitekerezo ntiryerekana ko igitekerezo kimwe “kibi”: ryerekana uburyo butandukanye no gusoma inkomoko zimwe mu buryo butandukanye.
FiqhWomenIntro.34: Ni ibisanzwe gukurikiza uburyo cyangwa madhab isanzwe ikurikizwa mu muryango cyangwa mu muryango mugari w’umuntu.
FiqhWomenIntro.36: Iyo imiterere yihariye y’idini ikomeje kutamenyekana, ni byiza rwose gusaba igitekerezo cy’umuhanga ubifitiye ububasha.
FiqhWomenIntro.37: Amakuru y’ubuvuzi ku kwezi (uburebure, ibimenyetso, ibyiciro by’imisemburo) n’amategeko y’idini abikomokaho (isuku, salat, isiyamu) bisubiza ibitekerezo bibiri bitandukanye: kimwe gisobanura ibintu by’ibinyabuzima, ikindi kigena urwego rw’imigenzo y’umwuka. Byombi bishobora kuzuzanya, ariko ntibigomba kwitiranywa.
FiqhWomenIntro.39: Gukurikirana ukwezi mu buvuzi n’ibimenyetso by’idini bibikomokaho buri kimwe gitanga ubumenyi bufite akamaro.

FiqhWomenIntro.42: AWA ifasha abakoresha gusobanukirwa ukwezi kwabo, aho ubuzima n’imigenzo y’idini bihurira, hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo kwigisha bwubaha itandukaniro riri hagati y’amashuri.

FiqhWomenIntro.46: Kumenya uko wagenda mu itandukaniro ry’amadhahib nta kwitiranya

FiqhWomenIntro.49: Gukurikirana amakuru afitiye akamaro imigenzo yawe y’idini, nibiba ngombwa

FiqhWomenIntro.59: Fiqh y’abagore ni urwego ruzima rwo gusobanura, rufite ibitekerezo bitandukanye rimwe na rimwe hagati y’amashuri. AWA igufasha gusobanukirwa ibanze no gutunganya ibibazo byawe, ariko igitekerezo cy’umuhanga ubifitiye ububasha gikomeza kuba isoko ku mwanzuro wose bwite w’idini.

FirstPeriod.1:
Imihango yawe ya mbere:
ibyo witeze
FirstPeriod.8: Imihango yawe ya mbere iza ryari?
FirstPeriod.13: Imihango yawe ya mbere iza ryari?
FirstPeriod.14: Akenshi ije hagati y’imyaka 10 na 15, hafi imyaka ibiri nyuma y’ibimenyetso bya mbere byo gukura.
FirstPeriod.16: Mu ntangiriro, ukwezi gushobora kuba kudahoraho, kugufi cyangwa kurekire. Umubiri wawe uri gufata igihe cyo kubona injyana yawo.
FirstPeriod.18: Imihango akenshi imara iminsi 3 kugeza kuri 7. Amaraso n’ibara bishobora guhinduka kuva ku munsi umwe ujya ku wundi.
FirstPeriod.20: Hindura igikoresho cyo kwirinda buri gihe, oga buhoro, kandi wambare imyenda yoroshye kugira ngo wumve utuje.
FirstPeriod.22: Ushobora kuvugana na nyoko, mushiki wawe, umuntu ukuri hafi, umwarimu, cyangwa umuganga wizeye.
FirstPeriod.24: Ukwezi kudahoraho mu ntangiriro ni ibisanzwe rwose. Umubiri wawe uracyiga uko wabona injyana yawo.
FirstPeriod.26: Buri mubiri ni umwihariko. Fata igihe cyawe, wihangane, kandi ntutinye gusaba ubufasha umuntu wizeye.

FirstPeriodComing.1:
Nzamenya nte ko imihango
yanjye ya mbere iri hafi?
FirstPeriodComing.6: Ibimenyetso bike bifatika bishobora kugufasha kumenya ko imihango yawe ya mbere iri hafi koko.
FirstPeriodComing.10: Ibisohoka mu gitsina cyangwa amaraso y’imihango?
FirstPeriodComing.11: Ni ryari ukwiye kuvugana n’umuntu mukuru?
FirstPeriodComing.13: Ibisohoka byoroheje, bisobanutse akenshi bigaragara amezi make mbere.
FirstPeriodComing.15: Ikimenyetso gisanzwe akenshi kigaragara kare mbere y’imihango yawe.
FirstPeriodComing.17: Ibyiyumvo bito nk’ibi bishobora kugaragaza ko imihango yawe iri hafi.
FirstPeriodComing.18: Mbere y’uko imihango yawe ya mbere ije, ni ibisanzwe kubona ibisohoka byoroheje byera cyangwa bisa n’umuhondo gato mu mwenda w’imbere. Ni ikintu gisanzwe, gifitanye isano n’imikorere y’imisemburo itangiye mu mubiri wawe.
FirstPeriodComing.19: Ibisohoka mu gitsina bisobanutse cyangwa byera, nta mpumuro ikomeye. Amaraso y’imihango ho ni umutuku kugeza ku ibara risa n’umukara, kandi agaragaza intangiriro nyakuri y’imihango yawe. Niba utazi neza, nta kibazo kiba kirimo kubiganiraho.
FirstPeriodComing.21: Nta buryo bwo guhanura umunsi nyawo. Guhorana igikoresho cyo kwirinda guhera ku bimenyetso bya mbere ni ingeso nziza.
FirstPeriodComing.22: Ukimara kubona ibi bimenyetso, cyangwa igihe cyose ufite ikibazo cyangwa impungenge, ushobora kuvugana na nyoko, mushiki wawe, umuntu ukuri hafi, cyangwa umuganga wizeye. Nta gihe kiba kibi cyo gusaba ubufasha.

FirstPeriodDailyLife.1:
Nacunga nte imihango yanjye
ya mbere buri munsi?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.6: Hamwe n’ingeso nke nto, imihango yawe ya mbere ihuza byoroshye n’ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi, ku ishuri no hanze yaryo.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.11: Ishuri, siporo, ibitotsi: imihango yawe ntikubuza gukomeza ibyo usanzwe ukora. Ukeneye gusa guhindura ingeso nke kugira ngo wumve utuje umunsi wose.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.12: Ishuri cyangwa ibikorwa: bika igitambaro cyangwa tampon mu gikapu cyawe
FirstPeriodDailyLife.13: Siporo: ushobora gukomeza gukora siporo, uhindure gusa umuvuduko
FirstPeriodDailyLife.14: Ibitotsi: igitambaro gikwiye cyo ku manywa n’ijoro kirahagije
FirstPeriodDailyLife.15: Agakapu gato karimo igitambaro kimwe cyangwa bibiri cyangwa tampon, umwenda w’imbere w’inyongera, n’impapuro zitose bishobora kujya byoroshye mu gikapu cy’ishuri cyangwa icya siporo. Kagufasha kumva utuje uko byagenda kose.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.17: Guhorana igitambaro cyangwa tampon bikurinda guhangayika wafashwe n’igitunguranye.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.18: Ibi bikunze kubaho, cyane cyane mu ntangiriro. Umuforomo w’ishuri, umwarimu, cyangwa inshuti hafi buri gihe agira ikintu cyafasha. Kuboha umwenda mu rukenyerero nabyo bishobora gufasha mu gihe ushaka igitambaro cyangwa tampon.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.20: Ni igitambaro cyangwa tampon iyihe nahitamo ku mihango yanjye ya mbere?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.24: Imihango yanjye ya mbere ntihora: ni ibisanzwe?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.26: Nacunga nte imihango yanjye ya mbere buri munsi? — AWA

FirstPeriodFaq.1:
Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
ku mihango yawe ya mbere
FirstPeriodFaq.6: Ibisubizo byoroshye ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku mihango yawe ya mbere.
FirstPeriodFaq.8: “Ese ni ibisanzwe kugira amaraso make cyane?”
FirstPeriodFaq.9: Yego. Ukwezi kwa mbere cyane akenshi kugira amaraso make. Amaraso ashobora gutandukana ku kwezi ku kundi, cyane cyane mu ntangiriro.
FirstPeriodFaq.11: Amaraso menshi nayo ashobora kubaho, cyane cyane mu minsi ibiri ya mbere. Niba ukeneye guhindura igikoresho cyawe cyo kwirinda inshuro irenga imwe mu isaha mu masaha menshi akurikirana, ni byiza kubiganiraho n’umuganga.
FirstPeriodFaq.13: Kubabara gato mu nda yo hasi ni ibisanzwe kandi akenshi nta mpamvu yo guhangayika. Icupa ry’amazi ashyushye cyangwa kuruhuka gato bishobora gufasha. Ububabare bukomeye cyane bukwiye kubwirwa umuntu.
FirstPeriodFaq.15: Yego, ushobora gukomeza gukora siporo mu gihe cy’imihango. Hindura gusa ubukana hakurikijwe uko umubiri wawe wumva uwo munsi.
FirstPeriodFaq.17: Yego, ushobora gukomeza koga ufite igikoresho gikwiye cyo kwirinda. Abantu benshi bahitamo gutegereza kugeza igihe bumva batuje kuri iyo ngingo.
FirstPeriodFaq.19: Nta kibazo giteye isoni kiriho: buri mubiri uratandukanye, kandi ushobora buri gihe kuvugana n’umuntu wizeye.
